tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The Consultant should pay 2.5% of the value of the price proposal as earnest money deposit (EMD) including GST in e-procurement portal in any of payment modes such as credit card/Direct debit/National electronic fund transfer (NEFT) over the counter (OTC). The EMD amount accepted in the form of electronic cash only and through Demand drafts or Bank guarantee) will be mentioned in the Government central pooling Account at Axis Bank/ Other Banks nominated by the Department of e-governance, until the contract is closed
The entire EMD amount of a particular tender is to be paid in a single transaction. For more details on e payment services refer to kppp portal

Within 20 days of receipt of the Letter of Acceptance, the successful Tenderer shall deliver to the Employer a Security deposit in any of the forms given below for an amount equivalent to 5% of the Contract price plus full difference amount for below quoted tenders as additional security (for unbalanced tenders) The additional performance security will be released proportionately to the bill amount till the contractor achieves progress of the entire cost of the work as per the agreement
The necessary certificates/documents in support of pre qualification criteria fulfilled as stipulated shall be scanned and attached to e tender documents
During the time of technical evaluation, if the employer finds that any certificate/information furnished is false, such bidders will be disqualified and barred from participating in the bid

The Technical bid will be opened first and there after the financial bids of those qualified in technical bid will be assessed on payment of tender processing fee. The financial bid will be opened subjected to the conditions that Electronic EMD payment is confirmed in the E-tender portal
If any bidder fails to satisfy the conditions mentioned above, such bids shall be rejected
The bidder should enclose the detailed methodology of execution of the scheme as per the scope of work
The Bidder shall be responsible for successful performance of the contract
The Bidder to participate in the tender under single bid basis only. Any violation will attract disqualification of bid
The consultants/authorized signatory should attach his/her signature to the Schedule B before uploading the documents
If any of the dates mentioned above happens to be a general holiday, the next working day holds good
Further information can be had from the undersigned during office hours
Conditional tenders are liable to be rejected. The officer competent to accept the tender shall have the right to reject any or all the tenders without assigning any reasons whatsoever

Corrigendum will be published in the website http://eproc.karnataka.gov.in for all modification / corrections if any. The contractor is responsible for any damages due to natural calamity the government or Nigam will not give any compensation for until the completion of maintenance period
The contractor should mention their recent correct portal address & mail address in declaration forms
The tender processing charges paid by the bidder/firm/company are not refundable even if the tender is cancelled
The bidder/firm/company shall send the authorization letter for their representation duly attending their signature
The bidder/firm/company shall adhere to accepted execution plan submitted by him under any circumstances without linking to the pending payment of the work && also land acquisition problems if any
Other terms and conditions as per Bid document & Tender Notification
Incomplete tender documents will be rejected
Tenders will be opened on the due date in presence of the contractor or their Authorized representatives
The contractor should furnish the name of the individual /firm with address and Telephone numbers with place of registration, year of incorporation etc

The tenderer has to make his own arrangement for procurement of all materials required for the work. There is no departmental supply of materials. Contractor should procure only ISI mark materials and submit necessary quality control certificates from the authorized quality control authority, before execution
No quarries are approved by KNNL for materials. The quarries considered are for the estimate purpose only
The validity period of EMD shall be for a minimum period of 225 days from the date of opening of the tenders
EMD of the unsuccessful bidders will be refunded only after the acceptance of tenders by the competent authority (of the Formal Tender Notice)
EMD of successful bidders will be refunded only after the Conclusion of the tenders
EMD amount and Amount put to tender will be as mentioned in the e-portal
The payment of bills of this work will be made as and when the letter of credit is received under the same head of account from KNNL/Government of Karnataka
The contractors should adhere to the accepted action plan submitted by him under any circumstances without linking to the pending bill payment of the work
Typographical errors, if any, will not be ground for any claims by the Consultant
Tenders from joint ventures are not acceptable

The tenderer is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance until the last date and time for the receipt of tenders. The department shall not be responsible for non-accessibility due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches

Any bidder who is otherwise technically qualified withdraws from the bidding process at any stage before a final decision is taken on the tender, the EMD of such bidder shall be forfeited, the name of such bidder shall be removed from the category list of Consultants at least for minimum period of one year in KNNL, besides making such bidder liable for blacklisting

In case of death of Consultant, after executing the agreement/commencement of work, his legal heir if any, eligible registered Consultant and willing can execute and complete the work at the accepted tender rates irrespective of the work

If the percentage quoted by the Consultant for the work is below 90% of the estimated amount put to tender or recast amount put to tender of the department, then the Consultant shall furnish additional performance security in the form of Bank Guarantee for an equivalent to the difference between the cost as per quoted percentage and 90% of the estimated amount put to tender or recast amount put to tender. In case of Consultant quotation rates above 125% of the estimated rates, then the amount over and above 125% will be withheld during the progress of work. The additional performance security will be released proportionally to the bill amount till the Consultant achieves progress of the entire cost of the work as per agreement

The intending Consultant should note that, if any of the lands (either in part/parts or in whole) required for the work is not yet acquired by the Nigam, it shall be the responsibility of the consultant to take possession of such land by consent from the owners before commencement of the work at no extra cost to the Nigam & no claims whatsoever relating to non availability of lands would be entertained
The increase in GST shall not be paid in the extended period of contract for which the contractor alone is responsible for delay as determined by the authority while granting the extension of time.
The officer competent to accept the tender shall have the right to reject/cancel any or all the tenders without assigning any reason whatsoever
The amount put to tender is exclusive of GST. The contractor shall quote the rate exclusive of GST
GST shall be paid to the tender amount as per prevailing Govt. Orders
The prevailing GST rates for the above contract amount shall be paid separately to the contractor during payment of bills of receipt of the GST to be paid by the contractor

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The intending bidder should have satisfactorily completed (not less than 90% of the contract value) as a prime contractor at least one similar work such as consultancy work for preparation of DPR for Bridge work Consultancy work costing not less than Rs. 4.89 Lakhs (usually not less than 50% of estimated value of contract) during last 5 years (2021-22 to 2025-26). An additional weightage of 10% each year will be added to the cost of work done to bring it to the present price level. The work done certificate should be obtained from a competent authority not below the rank of Executive engineer of the concerned division/equivalent officer/ Next higher officer. Note The intending bidder should have done the Consultancy work for the preparation of DPR for LIS Works should have completed minimum 3 works
Team Leader Minimum Qualification M.E/ M.Tech Minimum work Experience a) 5 Years 3marks b) 7 Years 4 marks c) 10 Years 5 marks
Senior Structural Engineer A Post-Graduate in Structural Engineering with minimum of 10 years experience in the relevant field a) 5 Years 3marks b) 7 Years 4 marks c) 10 Years 5 marks
Senior Quantity Surveyor Minimum Qualification B.E Civil Minimum work Experience a) 5 Years 3marks b) 7 Years 4 marks c) 10 Years 5 marks
I T Professional A computer analyst with minimum of 5 years experience a) 3 Years 3marks b) 4 Years 4 marks c) 5 Years 5 marks
Senior Geologist A Graduate in Geology with minimum of 10 years experience in the relevant field a) 3 Years 3marks b) 4 Years 4 marks c) above 5 Years 5 marks
Senior Surveyor A Graduate in Civil Engineering with minimum of 5 years experience in operation of Total Station and GPS equipment a) 3 Years 1marks b) 5 Years 2 marks c) above 5 Years 3 marks
CAD Draughtsman A Diploma in civil engineering with minimum 3 years experience in the relevant field. equipment a) 3 Years 1marks b) 5 Years 2 marks c) above 5 Years 3 marks
Description of Methodology The approach and methodology shall clearly define the Consultants approach to complete the assignment within the time frame a) Fair 5 marks b) Good 7 marks c) Best 10 marks
Technical Requirements availability of above equipment/software their owned.as per tender notification

The bidder should have an average annual financial turnover same as the amount put to tender for Rs. 8.28 Lakh in two financial years during the last five years (i.e,.2021-22 to 2025-26). Certificate issued by the Chartered Accountant mentioning UDIN No. should be enclosed (Additional weightage at 10% for each year shall be given for turn over to bring it to 2026-27)

The intending bidders are must advised to visit the site of work before submitting their tenders. The site visit Letter should be obtained from the concerned Assistant Executive Engineer, KNNL, No.1 Canal Sub Division, Kampli and uploaded in the e procurement. If the bidders fail to upload the documents the bid will considered as incomplete

itemList.itemName: Preparation of Bid Document for implementation of the scheme comprising, for intake structure, pumping machineries, electrical works, delivery chamber, raising main with surge protection works etc. with detailed cost estimates for supplement the water to suffering atchkat area around 3000 acres of tail end portion (beyond 3.25km) of Itagi Branch of Sugur Distributory under RBLLC by Lifting Water from Tungabhadra River near Itagi Village in Kampli taluk of Ballari District, as per schedule B

Preparation of Package Estimate for implementation of the scheme comprising, for intake structure, pumping machineries, electrical works,delivery chamber,raising main with surge protection works etc.with detailed cost estimates for supplement the water to suffering atchkat area around 3000 acres of tail end portion (beyond 3.25km)of Itagi Branch of Sugur Distributory under RBLLC by Lifting Water fromTungabhadra River near Itagi Village in Kampli taluk of Ballari District, as per Schedule B

Preparation of Detailed Project Report for construction of lift scheme comprising, intake structure, pumping machineries, electricalworks, delivery chamber,raising main with surge protection works etc. with detailed cost estimates for supplement the water to suffering atchkat area around 3000 acres of tail end portion (beyond 3.25km) of Itagi Branch of Sugur Distributory under RBLLC by Lifting Water from Tungabhadra River near Itagi Village in Kampli taluk of Ballari District. as per Schedule B
Geotechnical investigation by taking required Numbers of trial pits ortrial Bore.
Carrying out Topographical survey for supplement the Water to suffering atchkat area around 3000 acres including its Pipe Distribution network.

Collection of all necessary data such as preliminary report, relevant topo sheets of the area, current schedule of rates, nearest GTS benchmark etc. Collection of relevant topo sheets, Project Report, Combining all topo sheets, preparation ofindex map/alignment map, preliminary desk top study and preliminary planning of scheme and pipe distribution network.
